videō

videō, vidēre, vīdī, vīsum

verb, second conjugation: in this sense with ut or nē and the subjunctive · Conjugation on Wiktionary

see (to it) that; see

In this lexicon

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 16.1.2: nāvem idōneam ut habeās, dīligenter vidēbis (Lewis & Short)

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Mil. 3.1.35: clārē oculīs videō (Lewis & Short); Catull. 4.1; Traupman 376
